title: The Anatomy of a Good Incident
subtitle: A falsifiable, source-backed sequence that shows cause, choices, and effects.

panels.heading: Chat log is not timeline
panels.caption: Chats, alerts, and tickets become the timeline, hiding cause, order, and uncertainty.
panels.note: A tool echo log misorders events and hardens bias.

panels.heading: What a timeline is
panels.caption: A source-backed sequence ordered by occurred_at, with uncertainty and offsets explicit.
panels.note: Traceability over precision; anchor to verifiable sources; keep UTC canonical.

panels.heading: The better approach
panels.caption: Use a small schema and taxonomy; blend sources; mark confidence; verify with durable refs.
panels.note: Split decisions, actions, and state change; reconcile later with clear refs.

strip_caption: From capture to audit: a path to falsifiable, source-backed, UTC-ordered timelines.

steps.label: Capture with sources
steps.detail: Link evidence refs; prefer durable IDs

steps.label: Mark uncertainty
steps.detail: Record confidence and any known skew

steps.label: Reconcile and verify
steps.detail: Cross-check each entry with external proof
